name: io.github.munhq/chat-recall
description: One searchable memory across Claude Code, Gemini, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity and Cursor sessions.

environmentVariables.name: CHAT_RECALL_SERVER
environmentVariables.description: Server to sync to. Defaults to the hosted service at https://chatrecall.dev; set it to your own instance to self-host. Self-hosting is free for one person.

environmentVariables.name: CHAT_RECALL_MCP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Which tools to register: "lean" (default, 25 tools — tool choice degrades as the list grows) or "full" (all 58 tools, plus recall_help — a directory of the rest). Every tool works when called by name either way.

title: chat-recall
